ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before incorporation, screen all shareholders, directors, authorized signatories, beneficial owners, major counterparties and relevant banks against United Nations Security Council lists, directly applicable European Union financial-sanctions regulations, French national sanctions and asset-freeze measures, and commercially reliable adverse-media and PEP databases. PEP and family-member or close-associate treatment must follow Code monétaire et financier Articles L.561-10 and R.561-18 et seq., including senior-management approval, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, and enhanced ongoing monitoring. OFAC screening is not generally mandatory under French law without a United States nexus, but is commercially required by many banks and should be performed where USD clearing, United States persons, United States goods, or contractual sanctions clauses are involved. Escalate matches for identity resolution, document the disposition, prohibit circumvention, and file a TRACFIN report where legally required.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises operated by the Institut national de la propriété industrielle (INPI): https://formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; company and trade-name searches should also cover the Registre national des entreprises, Registre national des marques, and EUIPO databases.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be stated in the French incorporation documents and must not be misleading, unlawful, contrary to public order, or confusingly similar to a protected company name, trade name, trademark, domain name, or regulated activity. French accents and spelling may be used. A foreign-language or transliterated name is generally permissible if accurately recorded and non-misleading, but the legal name must be distinguishable in the registry. An SAS name must include or be followed by the designation Société par Actions Simplifiée or SAS. Name clearance is not a statutory grant of trademark rights.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, banque, établissement de crédit, payment institution, electronic money institution, insurance, assurance, brokerage, investment services and other regulated-finance terms where use could imply authorization
Mutuelle and other regulated insurance or mutual-sector designations where statutory conditions are not satisfied
Avocat, notaire, expert-comptable and other protected professional designations unless the applicable professional authorization and structure requirements are met
Governmental, public-authority, ministerial, national or international-organization designations that could create an official-capacity implication
Terms that falsely imply an approved public-interest, charitable, diplomatic, sovereign or regulatory status
Any name identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered company, trademark, trade name, domain name or protected geographical indication
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not provide a general statutory company-name reservation certificate with a guaranteed 30-day legal hold. The 30-day period is an operational planning window only. Conduct an INPI, RNE, RCS, trademark, domain and adverse-media search; retain evidence; file the SAS formation through the Guichet unique; and respond to any INPI or registry deficiency notice within the stated deadline. If the filing is rejected, obtain the written reason, correct the name or supporting documents, and resubmit through the Guichet unique. A formal appeal or challenge may be brought before the competent administrative court where the decision is an administrative decision, or before the competent commercial court for a registry-related commercial dispute; obtain French counsel advice on the competent forum and deadline. A rejection does not establish trademark infringement or guarantee priority over an earlier right.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A French SAS must have a registered office in France under Code de commerce Articles L.123-11 et seq. and L.227-1 et seq. A domiciliation company or serviced-office address may be used if the provider is authorized under Code de commerce Articles L.123-11-2 et seq., a written domiciliation contract is maintained, and the address permits receipt and retention of official correspondence. A simple mail-forwarding address, undisclosed nominee address, or address incapable of supporting customer due diligence is unsuitable. For bulk dehydrated vegetables and spice trading, a virtual office may be acceptable for a holding, sales and contracting function, but it does not replace any required warehouse, food-business, import, customs, traceability, labeling, storage, or product-safety arrangements. The company should maintain real management records, accounting records, banking controls, supplier files and transaction evidence in France or another demonstrably controlled location.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: No official French statistic establishes a general inspection probability for a newly incorporated SAS. A risk-based planning estimate for an ordinary low-risk trading company with a compliant domiciliation provider is approximately 5% to 15% during the first three years for an unannounced address or tax-related verification; the risk may materially increase for non-resident management, unexplained intra-group flows, high-risk jurisdictions, unusual customs activity, food-safety complaints, VAT anomalies, cash-intensive activity, or inconsistent registered-office information. This estimate is not a statutory probability and must not be treated as an enforcement guarantee.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code, particularly Articles L.227-1 to L.227-20 and R.227-1 to R.227-2 governing the Société par Actions Simplifiée, together with Articles L.123-1 et seq. and R.123-1 et seq. governing the Trade and Companies Register and corporate formalities.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: The competent commercial registry is the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés maintained by the competent Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce. Filing is submitted electronically through the national Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Electronic declaration of company creation through the Guichet unique, accompanied by the signed SAS articles of association, legal-publication certificate, capital-deposit certificate, beneficial-owner declaration, and supporting evidence for the registered office and officers.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital applies to an SAS; capital may be EUR 1 or any higher amount stated in the articles. At least 50% of cash contributions must be paid on incorporation, with the balance payable within five years of registration. Cash capital is deposited with a French bank, notary, or other legally authorized depositary, which issues the certificate of deposit. The deposited funds are released after registration upon presentation of the Kbis extract. Contributions in kind generally require an auditor's valuation unless the statutory exemption conditions are satisfied.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The shareholders, acting as the constituent body of [Company Name] SAS, acknowledge the valid subscription of all issued shares and approve payment of the required portion of cash contributions. The registered office is adopted at [full address], effective on incorporation. The shareholders appoint [name] as President for the term specified in the articles and, if applicable, appoint [name] as Directeur Général. The officers are authorized to represent the Company within their statutory and articles-based powers, open bank accounts, execute formation documents, publish the legal notice, submit the Guichet unique filing, and complete all registrations and ancillary formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirm Corporate Structure, Name, Activities, and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle online name and formalities services; competent Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce for registry matters
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Select the SAS form, confirm the corporate name, define the trading and import-export activities, identify the President and any Directeur Général, and secure a French registered office. Obtain written domiciliation or lease evidence. Conduct a trade-name and trademark clearance before signing the articles.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name and business description
Signed registered-office lease, domiciliation agreement, or premises ownership evidence
Identity documents and address evidence for shareholders and officers
Power of attorney for any filing representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Replace or supplement defective address evidence, correct the activity description, or amend the corporate name. If the registry raises an objection, respond through the Guichet unique within the stated cure period and retain the electronic submission receipt.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and Execute the SAS Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Private execution by the shareholders; notarial intervention only where required by the nature of an asset contribution or a specific transaction
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare articles covering name, form, purpose, duration, registered office, capital, share rights, transfer restrictions, shareholder decisions, President powers, optional executive officers, financial year, and liquidation provisions. Sign the articles electronically or manually. Notarization is not ordinarily required for a standard cash-capital SAS; notarization or a notarial deed is required where real estate or another legally protected asset is contributed.
required_dossiers: Contribution-in-kind report or auditor waiver, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct omissions or inconsistencies by executing amended articles before filing. If an in-kind contribution is challenged, appoint a commissaire aux apports or revise the contribution structure to cash.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A journal habilité à publier des annonces légales in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the statutory incorporation notice to an authorized legal-announcement publication service. The notice must state the company name, legal form, capital, registered office, purpose, duration, President, and relevant transfer and admission provisions. Obtain the attestation de parution before submitting the registration file.
required_dossiers: Payment confirmation for the legal notice
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request a corrected notice and replacement publication certificate where the notice contains a material error. If the notice was published in the wrong department, republish in the correct department and attach the valid certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit Share Capital and Obtain the Deposit Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French bank, notary, or other institution legally authorized to receive company-formation capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a formation account, provide the executed articles and identification package, transfer the subscribed cash capital, and obtain the certificat de dépôt des fonds. Ensure the deposit certificate matches the shareholder subscription schedule and the capital stated in the articles.
required_dossiers: Source-of-funds information requested under AML procedures
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct shareholder, capital, or identity mismatches with the depositary. If the bank declines onboarding, obtain a written explanation, remediate AML deficiencies, or use another authorized depositary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create the electronic filing, select company creation and SAS, upload the articles, legal-publication certificate, capital-deposit certificate, registered-office evidence, officer declarations, and beneficial-owner information. Pay the applicable registry and beneficial-owner charges, electronically sign the declaration, and preserve the filing receipt and tracking number.
required_dossiers: Officer identity documents and non-conviction declarations where required
Power of attorney, if filed by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Answer registry queries through the Guichet unique, upload corrected documents, and pay any additional charge requested. If rejected, correct the stated defect and resubmit; an adverse registry decision may be challenged or escalated under applicable commercial-registry procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Registration Evidence and Activate Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Competent Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce and Institut National de la Statistique et des Études Économiques for SIREN and SIRET allocation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Download the Kbis extract, SIREN/SIRET confirmation, and beneficial-owner filing evidence after acceptance. Convert the formation account into the operating account, issue the share certificates or maintain the statutory shareholder register, establish accounting records, and adopt the first governance resolutions. Confirm VAT, customs, and intra-Community transaction registrations as applicable.
required_dossiers: Final articles and first governance resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request correction of inaccurate Kbis, SIREN, SIRET, or beneficial-owner data through the Guichet unique or competent registry. Update changes through the same portal and preserve the amended filing acknowledgments.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No general manufacturing licence is required for ordinary wholesale trading and export of dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper. The relevant local authority for food-business registration, inspections, and sanitary controls is the Direction Départementale de la Protection des Populations. Where premises fall within an environmentally classified activity, the competent authority is the Préfecture, generally supported by the Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No general operating or manufacturing permit for ordinary dehydrated-spice trading. The operator must comply with food-business registration and notification requirements applicable to its activities, premises, storage, importation, and handling operations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for Ecological Transition, acting through the competent regional DREAL and the departmental Prefecture
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Generally exempt from a project-level EIA for ordinary warehousing and trading without industrial processing. An environmental authorization, registration, or declaration may be triggered under the French ICPE regime if the premises conduct drying, grinding, dust-generating processing, refrigeration, combustion, or storage above applicable nomenclature thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Operate within applicable ICPE, wastewater-discharge, air-emission, and waste-traceability requirements. Prevent spice dust and particulate emissions through appropriate containment, ventilation, filtration, housekeeping, and worker protection. Discharge wastewater only under the applicable public-sewer authorization or environmental permit and comply with its parameter limits. Segregate packaging, organic, hazardous, and non-hazardous waste; use authorized waste contractors and retain tracking records. Exact thresholds depend on equipment capacity, storage volume, discharge destination, and local prefectural requirements.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Before opening premises, obtain or maintain fire-safety compliance appropriate to the building classification, including emergency exits, extinguishers, alarms, evacuation signage, and fire-prevention controls. Verify structural floor loading and racking safety for bulk goods. Complete the required occupational-risk assessment, electrical and equipment inspections, workplace hygiene controls, dust-exposure assessment, and employee training. If the site is an établissement recevant du public or otherwise subject to public-access rules, obtain the applicable accessibility and safety approval from the competent municipal or departmental authority.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via official portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French SAS entities register with INSEE to obtain SIREN/SIRET; procure TVA/VAT ID by registering on DGFiP portal if annual taxable turnover exceeds €35,000 threshold
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; standard corporate taxation applies under French legal form with hybrid mismatch rules governed by ATAD directive

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing for all VAT-registered entities since 2024; real-time fiscal clearance via approved platforms with digital stamping and QR code authentication

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate on goods exported outside the EU upon proof of physical export and delivery abroad
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or CMR transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate or proof of payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims subject to 40% penalty on evaded VAT plus interest; retrospective clawback with 5-year statute of limitations

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains a fully convertible euro currency regime aligned with EU and IMF standards. Current account transactions, including trade settlements and profit remittances, face no prior authorization requirements for resident SAS entities. Capital account transactions are generally permitted without restriction for standard corporate operations, subject only to post-transaction reporting to tax authorities. Profit distributions to non-resident shareholders are unrestricted once tax compliance and beneficial ownership verification are satisfied.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or forced conversion of export proceeds exists under French law. Exporters may retain foreign currency in offshore or multi-currency accounts. All export transactions must nevertheless be supported by commercial invoices, packing lists, and shipping documents, and declared to Douane (customs) for statistical and fiscal reporting purposes. Repatriation remains voluntary but is strongly encouraged to mitigate FX and AML risks.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility for licensed French fintech EMI providers or international platforms such as Wise Business, subject to AMF authorization, full KYC/AML compliance, and adherence to French data localization rules. Offshore digital EMIs remain constrained by banking confidentiality and potential licensing requirements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors and authorized signatories is mandatory for initial KYC interviews and account opening at French commercial banks. Remote video KYC is permitted only in limited cases and not for complex cross-border structures involving non-resident ownership or high-value transactions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified extract from Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), beneficial ownership declaration form, and proof of ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) via corporate documents

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds verification for capital injections
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Export contracts, commercial invoices, proof of goods shipment, bank statements from origin country, and tax clearance certificates

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanction list screening and adverse media
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full screening reports from multiple databases and internal compliance review documentation

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections routed via SWIFT MT103 or SEPA Instant transfers using IBAN. Purpose codes must include 'EXPORT PROCEEDS', 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION', or equivalent. All transactions require matching documentation: commercial invoice, proof of export sale, and beneficial ownership verification. Use of Nostro/Vostro accounts for multi-currency management.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements cleared through SWIFT MT103 for direct wire transfers or issuance of irrevocable Commercial Letters of Credit (LCs) under UCP 600. Settlements processed via correspondent banking networks with proper purpose codes such as 'GOODS SUPPLY' or 'TRADE SETTLEMENT'. Platforms like TradeIX or bank treasury systems recommended for efficiency.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary shareholders' meeting (AGOA) approving the financial statements and profit appropriation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate act - minutes recorded in the shareholders' decisions register at the registered office; no separate governmental filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of fiscal year end (e.g., 30 June for a 31 December year end); court-authorized extension up to 6 additional months
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Any associate may petition the commercial court for injunction forcing the meeting; persistent failure exposes the president to liability and blocks lawful dividend distributions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of annual accounts (balance sheet, income statement, annex) and management report with the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS) via the INPI Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month of shareholder approval; effective outer limit 30 July for a 31 December year end (approval by 30 June)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registry formal notice, court injunction with coercive fine up to EUR 1,500; repeated omissions can trigger prosecutor-led strike-off (radiation) from the RCS.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: R&D tax credit (Crédit d'Impôt Recherche) up to 30% of eligible expenses; no general statutory tax holidays

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire 2065 (Déclaration de résultat) via impots.gouv.fr electronic portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 3 months after fiscal year-end (e.g., 31 March for 31 December year-end)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total taxable income and profits before adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents report only French-source income; allocate profits to French PE if permanent establishment exists
Restricted to French-source items; R&D credits claimed on separate form
Apply PE attribution rules and transfer pricing adjustments where relevant

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 0.5% of tax due per month of delay (max 25%); underpayment: 10-40% penalty (up to 80% for fraud); interest at 0.2% per month
